question: Find the simple interest on Rs. 600 at 7% per month in 9 months.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct Calculation: **Simple Interest** = **Principal** × **Rate** × **Time**

Since the rate is **7% per month** and time is **9 months**, units are consistent.

Total Interest % = 7% × 9 = 63%

SI = 63% of ₹600 = 0.63 × 600 = ₹378.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹378.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹600

Rate (R) = 7% per month

Time (T) = 9 months

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d978ba9de33649caad8fc3b33ce2991668d7a102e0bb1bce04cea1db292c7bfd.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = (600 × 7 × 9) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 6 × 7 × 9

⇒ SI = 42 × 9

⇒ SI = ₹378

**∴ The correct answer is ₹378.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Consistency in Simple Interest

Always ensure that the **Rate of Interest** and **Time** are in the same unit (e.g., both per year or both per month). If the rate is annual and time is in months, divide months by 12.

Formula for Amount

The total **Amount** (A) at the end of the period is the sum of Principal and Simple Interest: A = P + SI = P(1 + RT/100).

Difference between SI and CI

In **Simple Interest**, interest is calculated only on the initial principal, whereas in **Compound Interest**, interest is calculated on the principal plus the accumulated interest of previous periods.
